scalars.scalar_value: A minimum of one (1) year recent hospital experience as a Surgical Technologist

items.item_text: Completion of Surgical Technologist training. Completion of Certification as Surgical Technologist
Basic Life Support - CPR BLS, within 30 Days
Certified Surgical Technologist CST or Technologist in Surgery-Certified TS-C
A minimum of one (1) year recent hospital experience as a Surgical Technologist

Demonstrates intermediate or advanced skills in operating room technology and proficient knowledge of surgical procedures (as described in the Core Competencies and unit skills checklists). Measurement: Observation, Feedback.

Consistently demonstrates the principles of aseptic technique according to AORN Guidelines for Perioperative Practice, facility policy and procedures and the guidelines described in Universal Precautions. Measurement: Observation, Feedback.
Handles blood and tissue specimens accurately and in a timely manner. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Accuracy.
Consistently demonstrates proper care and handling of instruments and equipment according to AAMI/ANSI Standards. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Equipment condition.

Facilitates movement of surgery schedule through timely room turnover, communicating with appropriate persons for case progress and delays, through consistent and accurate anticipation of team needs. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Timeliness, Accuracy.

Identifies and responds to urgent/emergent situations in a calm and efficient manner. Consistently accepts assistance and direction, demonstrating sound judgement during emergency situations. Measurement: Observation, Feedback, Accuracy.
Two (2) years hospital experince as a Surgical Tech
